correctness.rationale: The published density is exactly a positive constant times \(p+1-x\) raised to \(p-1\). Its derivative has sign opposite to \(p-1\), and the endpoint limit is determined by the exponent \(p-1\). The log-density second derivative gives log-convexity below one and log-concavity above one. The hazard calculation is separate and remains increasing.

value.rationale: Density shape is a core advertised property of the new bounded lifetime family and is used to interpret how the parameter changes concentration near the support boundary. The published description reverses the entire subunit regime and claims an endpoint singularity where the density actually vanishes for p>1. Correcting the phase diagram changes the mode and boundary interpretation across the whole parameter space while preserving the valid IFR result.
